segments.contextAfter: **Dynamic interface**: Displays content that you can configure at runtime based on the notification’s payload. When designing a dynamic notification interface, use labels, images, groups, and separators to build the bulk of your interface. Include tables and maps only as needed. You can also use SpriteKit scenes, SceneKit scenes, or inline videos to produce visually rich notifications. Don’t include buttons, switches, or other interactive controls.
